title: The Jungle Book
tagline: Get the honey. Get the bear.
about: A boy raised by wolves journeys through the jungle with a panther and a bear as a tiger hunts him.
cue: Serve dessert when Mowgli climbs the cliff to bring Baloo the honey.
faces: Relax, kid. Grab some fruit off the tree and lie back. Dinner's better when nobody's in a hurry.
